about: Which fetched tariff documents (tools/fr/fetch.py output) are parsed, how, and what they cover. 'list' documents give one row per entry-exit pair with the five class prices in EUR including VAT (TTC); 'grid' documents are VINCI Autoroutes' class grids, one PDF page per class (parse.py, grid.py). All the listed documents are priced together as one French system: a trip pays, in order along the route, for the longest entry-exit pairs these documents publish (tools/fr/build.py).

documents.covers: APRR network, with trips to and from A79 (ALIAE) through Deux-Chaises
A41 Nord (Liane), with trips to and from AREA
A79 free flow and the Deux-Chaises barrier, with trips to and from APRR
ASF network (VINCI Autoroutes south and west), with trips to and from Cofiroute, Arcour, APRR and AREA that ASF charges at its exits
Escota network (A8, A50, A51, A52, A57, A500): Provence and the Côte d'Azur
Cofiroute network (A10, A11, A28, A71, A81, A85), with trips to and from APRR, AREA, ASF and Sanef that Cofiroute charges at its exits
